Paywall and cancellation, as built

Every frame is the current build (main, commit 387c94d0, the one atuned.world published on 16 October), photographed in a real browser. A is what a person meets before paying. B is how they stop. Arrow keys step. D and P switch desktop and phone. Each frame says LIVE, CLOSED, NOT BUILT, DRAFT or NOT OURS, and what that means.
